title: Jasmine Interiors
description:
A complete interior fit-out for a home at Jasmine, Vasai West - planned down to the last detail.

Custom furniture, a media wall with layered wood panelling, and modular kitchen cabinetry were built to fit the space exactly, while cove lighting, pendant fixtures and accent wall lights carry a warm, modern feel through every room.

Every corner was planned for efficient space management, from the compact kitchen run to the sit-out balcony, so the home feels open and uncluttered without losing storage.

gallery.alt: Living room media wall with wood panelling and pendant lights
